2026-10-03 Merriweather Post Pavilion, Columbia, MD

Share: 

Scheduled: 13:00 | Local Start Time ??:?? / End Time 22:50

Info & Setlist | Venue

Bruce Springsteen joins Tom Morello and his band for the closing set of the Power to the People Festival, a celebration of peace, justice, solidarity, music, and community action curated by Morello. Bruce begins with a solo acoustic "Streets Of Minneapolis" and an acoustic duet with Joan Baez on "Chimes Of Freedom" before being joined by Morello and his band along with various guests. Other performers (with various collaborations between acts) include The Neighborhood Kids, The Last Internationale, State Radio, grandson, The Linda Lindas, "Jack Sabbath" (Jack Black with Roman Morello, Revel Ian, Yoyoka Soma, and Hugo Weiss) featuring Geezer Butler, Killer Mike, Cypress Hill, Nathaniel Rateliff, Morello (featuring Serj Tankian, B-Real, Daryl "D.M.C." McDaniels, and Scott Ian), "Sons of Soundgarden" (Matt Cameron, Mike McCready, Taylor Momsen, Morello, and Robbie Mangano), Public Enemy, Dave Matthews, Baez, Stephen Stills, Dropkick Murphys (featuring Matt Hensley and Michael Fanone), and Foo Fighters, alongside artwork and a DJ set by legendary artist Shepard Fairey.
